summary.name: Vectr
summary.one_liner: Vectr is a browser-based vector graphics editor with AI tools for logo making, image-to-vector conversion, background removal, and text-to-image generation.
use_cases: Converting JPG or PNG images into SVG vectors
Removing backgrounds from product photos and profile pictures
Collaborating with a team on vector designs in real time
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a cloud-based vector editor for creating and editing vector graphics online, with shapes, path editing, text insertion, and image uploads. It includes AI tools for vectorizing images, one-click background removal, text-to-image generation, inpainting, outpainting, and object removal. Users can export designs as SVG, PNG, and JPG, and the page lists opening formats including SVG, PNG, JPG, EPS, AI, PDF, and SVGZ. Real-time workspace sharing and chat are offered for team use, with sync across devices.
notable: AI vectorizer converting raster images to editable SVG vectors
Real-time collaboration with shared workspace and integrated chat
Cloud-based editor with sync across devices
Listed as freeware in awesome-mac Design Tools
caveats: Opening EPS, AI, PDF, and SVGZ files requires credits, according to the FAQ
Pricing and plan details are not stated on the page
Works best in Chrome per the FAQ
